verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since an IP office runs deadline-driven processes like maintenance fees, renewals and reinstatement. CIPO's pages do cover these topics: paying maintenance fees, reinstating abandoned applications, reversing deemed expiry, trademark renewal, and fee pages for integrated circuit topographies. However, none of the evidence shows actual deadline dates, late-fee amounts or any penalty or interest schedule. missing for 10: published exact deadline dates, exact late-fee/penalty figures, any interest schedule, and independent corroboration that these figures are clearly published.
